lane: SQL + Edge: Admin redesign step A4 backend (D1, D2, minimal D3, E2)
goal: Prepare, without applying, the backend for Admin step A4 (spec ADMIN_SCREENS_SPEC_2026-11-04 section 4): an emergency switch row for oracle_router (D1); a versioned public.ai_feature_configs table with draft/active/archived rows and three audited RPCs (D2); a per-feature total model deadline taken from the active config instead of the hard-coded 40 s / 60 s (minimal D3); and a shared Edge reader that lets the active config override the existing daily limits of Chat, Oracle, Tarot, Daily, Astrology deep read and Council (E2). With no table, no active row or a read error, every function behaves exactly as today.
successCriteria: Migration 20261113090000 adds oracle_router to the allowed switch features on top of 20261111090000, seeds an enabled row idempotently and keeps set_ai_feature_switch rules (ai.manage, reason 3-200 characters, audit log).

Migration 20261113090100 creates public.ai_feature_configs with one active row per feature (partial unique index), RLS on and no client grants, plus get_ai_feature_configs (ai.read), save_ai_feature_config_draft (ai.manage) and publish_ai_feature_config (ai.manage, note of 10+ characters, archives the previous active row, audit log); functions are security definer with an empty search_path and not executable by anon.

supabase/functions/_shared/feature-config.ts reads active rows with the service key over REST with a short timeout and a 60 s in-memory cache, and returns null (defaults) when the table is missing, empty or unreadable.

Persona chat, Oracle, Tarot, Daily Insight, Astrology deep read and Council use quota_daily (and Council follow_ups) from the active config when present; otherwise the current numbers 5, 5, 1, 3, 1 and 1+4.
The model router accepts an optional total deadline: without it each attempt keeps 40 s (60 s for astrology_report); with it the attempts share the deadline and never exceed it.

Deno tests for the reader and the deadline pass; deno check passes for every touched function; the migrations run on PGlite with assertions; validate:backend, supabase:check, supabase:migration-ledger:check and prompt:consumers:check stay as before.
untouchedSurfaces: apps/admin is not touched here; another agent builds the A4 screens against the RPCs described in the handoff.
No migration is applied and no Edge Function is deployed by the agent: the Owner approves each by hash.
supabase/migration-ledger.json describes the old QA project and is not changed.
ai-astrology-report (being retired into deep read) keeps its policy limit and is not a configurable feature.
No context_vars, voice_knobs or safety columns (A5) and no eval tables (A6); copy and cost_cap_micro are stored but not yet read by any function.
Mobile app, request bodies and response shapes are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Admin AI feature screens (A4) call get_ai_feature_configs, save_ai_feature_config_draft and publish_ai_feature_config; six AI Edge Functions read the active row before their limit check.
impact.dataWrite: New table public.ai_feature_configs (Admin-written configuration only, no user data) and one switch row oracle_router; admin_audit_logs rows for draft saves and publishes.
impact.backendContract: No request or response shape changes. A published config can change the daily limit (still 429 daily_limit_reached) and shorten or lengthen the total model wait within 5-140 s.
impact.adminVisibility: Admin sees all versions per feature with status, values, gate status and who published; every save and publish is audited with action ai.feature_config.draft / ai.feature_config.publish.
impact.privacySafety: No personal data stored or sent; the reader uses the service key only server-side and selects configuration columns only.
impact.observability: admin_audit_logs; usage_events metadata keeps the applied limit per attempt as today.
impact.rollback: Publishing an older version or archiving all rows returns functions to code defaults within 60 s (cache); dropping the table also falls back to defaults. Switch row: delete oracle_router (missing row means on).
